pins.definition: Feeling displeasure or anger because of something that happened.
Feeling strong displeasure or intense anger.
Easily agitated, irritable, or showing visible signs of anxiety.

situation: A man at his home office desk has just discovered his laptop screen is cracked right down the middle.
subject: the strong displeasure and fury
brief: A man sits rigidly at his desk with his jaw clenched and fingers tightly gripping the edge of the table, staring at a sudden fracture across his computer monitor. Heavy, sharp ink lines radiate from his clenched fist and furrowed brow, capturing an intense wave of boiling frustration.
prompt: A man sits rigidly at his desk with his jaw clenched and fingers tightly gripping the edge of the table, staring at a sudden fracture across his computer monitor. Heavy, sharp ink lines radiate from his clenched fist and furrowed brow, capturing an intense wave of boiling frustration. a single black-and-white manga panel, dense screentone, hard ink blacks, dramatic foreshortening and speed lines, one held expression. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
